messages.subject: Boxplot with different datasets
parts:
Hi!

I have five different datasets.
With these individual set, I want to draw boxplot.

I did (it was successful with graphic module).

names <- c("BLA", "Hom", "Hum", "Inp", "MAC")
boxplot(bla$needle, hom$needle, hum$needle, inp$needle, mac$needle,
col="red", names=names,boxwex=0.3,outwex=0.2,staplewex = 0.2,
border="grey",cex.axis=1.3, main="N-W",cex.main=1.5,las=2)

How can I do like above with ggplot2?

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: Boxplot with different datasets
parts:
Hi Teragene,

Just combine them into one data frame.

bla$source <- "BLA"
hom$source <- "Hom"
...

all <- rbind(bla, hom)

qplot(source, needle, data = all, geom="boxplot")

Hadley
